mode: UTF-8, standard_conforming_strings on, pg_catalog first, default heap access and stock builtin assignment casts.
structure: Each ordered column owns its resolved storage identity and a default expression with an int4 or int8 source identity, native text or NULL, or absence. Integer operands carry a canonical signed decimal and their resolved source width. The owning column determines exactly which native assignment conversion applies.
conditions: Accept every checked int4 or int8 literal source in an ordinary SMALLINT, INTEGER, BIGINT or pg_catalog.text declaration, including a source that cannot fit the eventual numeric field. Require known builtin storage and exact literal roles. A constant cast from int4 or an int8 literal to the builtin int8 type is an admitted int8 source expression. An operand beyond signed int8 is outside this literal domain.
meaning: Store the resolved, unevaluated default expression in the new table. At a default insertion, PostgreSQL coerces it to the field type using the stock assignment rules. Preserve exact signed values, signed-to-text conversion, a SQLSTATE 22003 narrow assignment failure, and SQLSTATE 23502 for a required field with an absent or NULL default. Supplying an explicit in-range value in every column bypasses its defaults. CREATE TABLE and these writes are transactional.
sql: Emit the resolved storage or text type and the canonical operand. Identify an int8 default with explicit CAST AS pg_catalog.int8 so even in-int4-range int8 operands retain their source width.
observations: Ordered catalog column names, target field types, nullability and presence of a stored default
Resolved default operand type and value as reported by the catalog
Typed default row or exact SQLSTATE when the default is applied
Explicit replacement row after a default success or failure, table visibility and rollback

finite.completeness: Recover the destination, source type and value, nullability, existence policy and measured fixture occupancy from the actual observed structure and environment.

analysis: A resolved int8 cast of an in-range int4 constant
Text and integer fields combined in declared order

exploration.requiredForms: Vary signed width, in-range and out-of-range offsets, required/default flags, mixed column order, text conversions, catalog occupancy and transactional restoration.

negative: Text literal in the numeric role
A Boolean literal in the signed declaration domain
A resolved nonliteral default outside the checked literal roles

evidence.P01: Resolve the catalog type, source type, default operand, qualified target and column order.
evidence.P02: Enforce the exact literal source and storage roles before publication.
evidence.P03: Keep only the resolved, immutable operation and operands.
evidence.P04: Derive assignment from the source and destination roles.
evidence.P05: Use only finalized immutable numeric and text values within an owned list.
evidence.P06: Reproduce the native declaration and deferred assignment behavior.
evidence.Q01: Reject sources outside the typed construction and closed literal domain.
evidence.Q02: Exhaust the complete registered finite grid, including native overflow defaults and successful explicit replacements.
evidence.Q03: Compare typed default effects in mixed ordered definitions and composed assignments.
evidence.Q04: Compare catalog roles and actual saved rows or exact native failures under both releases.
evidence.Q05: Tie audited method shapes, installed PHP, comparison outputs and replay to the same candidate identity.

open: Numeric defaults beyond the signed int8 source domain
General column expressions, configurable or added casts and explicit narrowing cast syntax
Other native column storage families and modifiers
trust: Independent interpretation of int4, int8 and the destination assignment ranges
Native catalog representation of literal and cast expressions
